coreAttributes.name: flashlight
coreAttributes.description: An arcane-powered flashlight. As well as being able to illuminate even the darkest of areas, this sturdy torch could also be used as an impromptu baton...
coreAttributes.equipText: [npc.Name] ready [npc.her] flashlight and prepare to use it to illuminate any dark areas [npc.she] encounter.

hitDescriptions.hitText: Swinging [npc.her] flashlight, [npc.name] manage to whack [npc2.name] on the [npc2.arm], which causes [npc2.herHim] to let out a surprised yelp!
Striking out at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] flashlight, [npc.name] manage to land a solid hit on [npc2.her] [npc2.arm]!
With a quick step forwards, [npc.name] lunge out at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] flashlight, whacking the heavy end against [npc2.her] shoulder!

missDescriptions.missText: Thrusting out with [npc.her] flashlight, [npc.name] attempt to whack [npc2.name] on the [npc2.arm], but end up missing [npc2.herHim]!
Striking out at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] flashlight, [npc.name] let out a frustrated cry as [npc.she] miss [npc.her] target!
With a quick step forwards, [npc.name] lunge out at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] flashlight, but [npc.she] miss [npc.her] target!
